boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten named Miami University Natural Areas destinations for an outdoor walk, birdwatching break, or low-key meetup without an admission charge.

cards.title: Walk Bachelor Preserve
cards.subtitle: Miami University Natural Areas
cards.notes: Choose a marked route before heading out, keep your group together on the trail, and pause at the pond or bridge only where conditions feel comfortable.
cards.short_summary: A wooded preserve for a self-paced outdoor walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Miami University states that its Natural Areas trails are open to all and free of charge.
cards.source_title: Miami University Natural Areas and Trails
cards.access_notes: Use the official Natural Areas trail map and follow posted trail guidance.

cards.title: Follow Bachelor Pond Trail
cards.subtitle: Miami University Natural Areas
cards.notes: Bring water, pick a turnaround point together, and use the marked trail rather than creating a shortcut through the surrounding natural area.
cards.short_summary: A named Natural Areas route around Bachelor Pond.
cards.evidence_claim: Miami University states that its Natural Areas trails are open to all and free of charge.
cards.source_title: Miami University Natural Areas and Trails
cards.access_notes: Consult Miami’s current Natural Areas trail map before departure.

cards.title: Meet at Reinhart Reserve
cards.subtitle: Miami University Natural Areas
cards.notes: Use this reserve for a conversation walk through the wooded and meadow landscape, staying on designated paths and leaving plants and wildlife undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A reserve with connecting trails, woods, and meadows.
cards.evidence_claim: Miami University states that its Natural Areas trails are open to all and free of charge.
cards.source_title: Miami University Natural Areas and Trails
cards.access_notes: The Natural Areas visitor page identifies trails connecting through the reserve.

cards.title: Take a College Woods Loop
cards.subtitle: Miami University Natural Areas
cards.notes: Set an easy pace for a study break, watch your footing on unpaved sections, and return before dusk rather than extending the walk after dark.
cards.short_summary: A named woods loop near Miami’s Oxford campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Miami University states that its Natural Areas trails are open to all and free of charge.
cards.source_title: Miami University Natural Areas and Trails
cards.access_notes: Check the official map for the College Woods Loop route.

cards.title: Stroll Silvoor Biological Sanctuary
cards.subtitle: Miami University Natural Areas
cards.notes: Take a slow loop with friends and look for seasonal wildflowers; keep to the route so the sanctuary’s planted and natural areas remain protected.
cards.short_summary: A compact sanctuary known for its wildflower collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Miami University states that its Natural Areas trails are open to all and free of charge.
cards.source_title: Miami University Natural Areas and Trails
cards.access_notes: Miami lists the sanctuary entrance at 910 Silvoor Lane.

cards.title: Walk Peffer Woods Trail
cards.subtitle: Miami University Natural Areas
cards.notes: Make this a phone-down walk: choose a trail section, listen for birds, and use the official map to stay oriented at trail connections.
cards.short_summary: A named wooded trail in the Natural Areas system.
cards.evidence_claim: Miami University states that its Natural Areas trails are open to all and free of charge.
cards.source_title: Miami University Natural Areas and Trails
cards.access_notes: Route details and trail connections appear on Miami’s Natural Areas map.

cards.title: Try DeWitt Peffer Trail
cards.subtitle: Miami University Natural Areas
cards.notes: Plan a daylight walk with a friend, wear shoes suited to uneven ground, and use the route’s mapped trailhead rather than roadside stopping.
cards.short_summary: A mapped Natural Areas trail connecting wooded destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: Miami University states that its Natural Areas trails are open to all and free of charge.
cards.source_title: Miami University Natural Areas and Trails
cards.access_notes: Use the official map for route length and trailhead planning.

cards.title: Take the Marcum Loop
cards.subtitle: Miami University Natural Areas
cards.notes: Use the loop for a short reset between commitments, agreeing on the route first and respecting posted conditions or temporary trail maintenance work.
cards.short_summary: A mapped loop trail near the Oxford campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: Miami University states that its Natural Areas trails are open to all and free of charge.
cards.source_title: Miami University Natural Areas and Trails
cards.access_notes: Confirm the loop and connecting paths on Miami’s current trail map.

cards.title: Explore Ruder Preserve
cards.subtitle: Miami University Natural Areas
cards.notes: Keep the outing simple: follow the mapped preserve trail, take photos from the path, and pack out anything you bring into the natural area.
cards.short_summary: A named preserve connected to Miami’s trail network.
cards.evidence_claim: Miami University states that its Natural Areas trails are open to all and free of charge.

cards.title: See Harker’s Run Swinging Bridge
cards.subtitle: Miami University Natural Areas
cards.notes: Add the bridge as a waypoint on a marked hike, cross calmly one person at a time if posted guidance requires it, and avoid climbing or crowding it.
cards.short_summary: A named bridge landmark along the Natural Areas trails.
cards.evidence_claim: Miami University states that its Natural Areas trails are open to all and free of charge.
cards.source_title: Miami University Natural Areas and Trails
cards.access_notes: Check the official map and on-site signage before incorporating the bridge into a hike.
